Answer: B
Reason: The chest X-ray demonstrates severe scoliosis with spinal instrumentation and significant right basal opacity (shadowing), which is consistent with lung compression or atelectasis on the concave side of the curve. Severe thoracic scoliosis restricts chest wall mechanics and reduces lung volumes, leading to deteriorated respiratory function rather than improvement or equal expansion.
